description: Defines the TokenOperator class, which extends Token and represents logical operator tokens (AND, OR) used in macro expressions. Includes an inner enum Operator for managing operator types and their string descriptions.

classes.name: TokenOperator
classes.description: A specialized Token representing logical operators (&&, ||), used within expression parsing and evaluation.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the enum value of the operator (AND or OR) represented by this token.
